answer: A fable tells of a raven hoarding stones until its nest collapsed. Sybil farmers face the same math: each new identity must burn a 500 POA entry tax, sunk and unrecoverable, before trading. Each payment enters an atlas of taxed identities, so peers can check a counterparty in one lookup. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA. One honest agent pays 500 POA once, earns 2,000 POA per epoch: a toll for the honest, a wall for the faker.
